data.title: Bedroom and Living Room Furniture
data.summary: Realistic modern beds, sofas, chairs, tables, lamps, wardrobes and soft dressing for bedrooms and living rooms.
data.description: A modern realistic bedroom and living room furniture library in metre units: upholstered and timber beds, two and three seat sofas, dining and task chairs, coffee, dining, side, writing and console tables, floor, table, pendant and wall lamps, hinged and sliding wardrobes, drawer chests, a stocked bookcase and rugs, curtains and cushions. Doors, drawers and the blanket-box lid are named nodes pivoted on their hinge or slide axes with rigid open and close clips. Every file is self-contained CC0 geometry with no collision or navigation data.
